room_rent.display: 1% of SI/day (or Single Pvt AC room)
room_rent.note: Options per schedule: 1% of base SI/day OR Single Private AC room OR at actuals up to SI; baseline is capped

icu.note: Options: 2% of base SI/day OR actual ICU/ICCU OR at actuals up to SI

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base; optional voluntary co-pay 10%/20% (Section E.6) for premium discount

sub_limits.note: Caps on genetic disorder (₹1L), bariatric, congenital (25% SI); main IPD up to SI

deductible.note: Deductible does not reduce SI; not standard

cumulative_bonus.note: 15% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%; reduced at same rate on claim

restoration.note: Sum Insured Refill 100% base SI once/policy year on full/partial utilization; single claim cannot exceed base SI + bonus

post_hosp.note: 60/90/180 days per schedule; baseline 90 (up to 180 available)

ayush.note: In-patient AYUSH in govt/AYUSH hospital, within India

global_cover.note: Domestic emergency assistance only; no overseas cover

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity (Excl 18); genetic disorder & congenital sub-limited; standard IRDAI exclusions

optional_riders.display: Voluntary co-pay (10%/20%), pre/post-hosp & SI-refill tier options, Recovery/Compassionate-visit add-ons
